classes.name: Aventra — Elizabeth line
classes.primaryService: Elizabeth line — Reading/Heathrow to Paddington to Liverpool Street to Abbey Wood / Shenfield
classes.notes: 70 nine-car trains as built. A June 2024 Alstom order added 10 more, taking the fleet to 80; those are being built at Derby Litchurch Lane and were in testing at the time of writing. Central section through London opened May 2022 (Crossrail). Capacity ~1,500 passengers per train.
classes._why: CORRECTS THIS FILE'S OWN EARLIER CORRECTION. The export's commuter Notes said '80 nine-car trains' and the 2026-08-04 first pass treated that as an error against the duplicate metro row's '70', because the two rows contradicted each other. Verification shows BOTH were right about different things: 70 were built for the opening fleet, and a June 2024 Alstom order for 10 more takes it to 80. So the original 80 was a forward-looking figure, not a mistake. numberBuilt now carries the as-built 70 with the expansion qualified in the same string, and the detail lives in Notes — the existing field that already fits. NO new schema field was added; see the report for the flag about whether fleet-in-flux deserves one.

classes._why: Normalised 2026-08-04. This row said 'Sheffield Supertram / South Yorkshire Supertram' while the Class 399 row said 'Sheffield Supertram', so one network appeared as two in any naming-based count. Checked the operator's own branding rather than guessing: Travel South Yorkshire brands the network simply 'Supertram', and 'South Yorkshire Supertram' is the form used in official documentation. 'Sheffield Supertram' is used here because bare 'Supertram' is ambiguous in a UK-wide database and 'Sheffield Supertram' is the common recognised name (and already the string on the 399 row), so this is a normalisation onto an existing value rather than a rename. NOTE also that ownership passed from Stagecoach to the South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority on 22 March 2024 via South Yorkshire Future Trams Ltd — flagged, not changed, since no row currently names an operator for this fleet.
